name: Reaper Haunt leaves a visage of the caster that clones the caster and runs away
contract: Haunt (573425) reads 'Create a visage of yourself that runs away from you to fool enemies' and summons the creature its summon effect names (840000 in older Spell.dbc builds, 990020 since the 2026-09-24 client patch; 840000 is the same creature Uncanny Likeness Mirage 501136 leaves behind, see #298). A visage of the Reaper must look like the Reaper, including customization and equipment: the native way to make a creature render as a specific player is the clone-caster aura (Clone Me! 45204, SPELL_AURA_CLONE_CASTER), which sets the caster's display and the mirror-image flag so the client asks for the player's appearance (SMSG_MIRRORIMAGE_DATA). A bare player display id without it renders the uncustomized, untextured body #298 reported for the Mirage copy, which the Reaper branch of npc_ascension_witch_doctor still set; the visage therefore carries the Reaper's Clone Me! aura and display and runs away from the Reaper. Haunt requires stealth, so the fixture applies a stealth aura. Haunt has three charges with a 30-second recharge. A cast consumes one charge, which must remain spent after the four-second movement observation.

steps.label: The visage looks like the Reaper
The visage clones the Reaper's appearance through Clone Me!
The running visage still carries the clone
The spent charge has not recharged after four seconds
